| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Most keypoints** `maxFeatures` | 500 | 10 to 5000 | Keep at most this many keypoints, the strongest over all levels. OpenCV uses 500. |
| **Scale factor** `scaleFactor` | 1.2 | 1.05 to 2 | The image shrinks by this factor from one pyramid level to the next. OpenCV uses 1.2. |
| **Pyramid levels** `levels` | 8 | 1 to 16 | The number of pyramid levels. OpenCV uses 8. |
| **FAST threshold** `fastThreshold` | 20 | 1 to 100 | How much brighter or darker the circle must be than the center, in levels. OpenCV uses 20. |
| **Ranking** `scoreType` | Harris measure | Harris measure, FAST score | How corners are ranked before the strongest are kept. OpenCV uses the Harris measure. |
